title: GitHub Trending Input
description: Pull the GitHub trending list for any timeframe, programming language, or spoken language.

timeframes.title: Timeframes
timeframes.description: Which trending windows to scrape. Pick any of daily, weekly, monthly.

languages.title: Programming languages
languages.description: Filter trending by programming language slug. Examples: 'python', 'typescript', 'rust', 'go'. Leave empty to scrape the all languages list.

spokenLanguageCode.title: Spoken language code
spokenLanguageCode.description: Filter by author's spoken language. Two letter ISO code, for example 'en' or 'zh'. Leave empty for all.

maxReposPerList.title: Max repos per list
maxReposPerList.description: Hard cap per timeframe and language combination. GitHub trending shows up to 25 repos per list. 0 means take everything.

includeContributors.title: Include top contributors
includeContributors.description: Pull the small avatars under each repo (the 'Built by' row) with username and profile URL.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Datacenter is fine for GitHub trending.
